goal: Implement approved 5 shared Chat/Oracle and 1 one-card Tarot daily limits plus USD5/day and USD50/14-day QA reservation contract; local PostgreSQL WASM replay and fake-provider orchestration only, never activate live spending or rewrite legacy ledger.
successCriteria: Policy records human approval on 2026-10-02; campaign is seeded disabled without fabricated start date and no live activation.

Quota and integer microUSD day/campaign holds occur in one transaction; replay/conflicting owner/spec cannot obtain second worker lease or provider dispatch; Tarot one-card and shared Chat/Oracle group enforced.

Known per-attempt costs settle; unknown/dispatched failures retain conservative cost holds while returning failed user quota; successful persisted-result replay returns reference with no second provider call.
All tables have RLS and customer grants revoked; only service_role invoker RPCs access private meter. No private text stored; anonymous/customer calls denied in actual local SQL fixtures.
Execute new SQL in PGlite0.5.8 PostgreSQL WASM with synthetic auth/result fixtures; explicitly do not claim multi-connection concurrency, full25-migration replay or Supabase/live readiness.

Deno pure worker/fake-store and local SQL tests cover same request, shared sixth turn, second Tarot, quota refund, unknown costs, caps, receipt ownership, missing store, persistence/finalization failure and UTC+7 boundaries.
untouchedSurfaces: No live writes, project retarget, historical migration rewrite, deploy, publish or release.
App/account bridge and privacy integration require separate root record; historical planning backlog untouched.

impact.entryPoint: Backend-only reusable metered-operation/store contract for protected AI core; current app/gateway/router remains untouched until separate integration preflight.
impact.dataWrite: Local new policy, unapplied SQL, meter/store/tests/docs and isolated test runtime only. New private rows contain UUID/feature/keyed digest/cost states/result reference, no request/response text or credentials.
impact.backendContract: Server-owned authenticated operation spec, reserve/claim/attempt receipt/finalize service-only RPCs; day/campaign lock ordering, unknown cost retention and no automatic retry after dispatch; not legacy credit debit.
impact.adminVisibility: Future aggregate used/reserved/warnings contract noted, no UI mock read or published config; current protected workspaces retained.
impact.privacySafety: RLS enabled and ALL privileges revoked from PUBLIC/anon/authenticated; SECURITY INVOKER and service-only wrapper grants; user deletion anonymizes meter identity, no raw prompts/results saved in ledger.
impact.observability: Sanitized status/counters only; test report records engine version/hash/cases and limitations, not tokens/private rows.
impact.rollback: Unapplied source removable per exact slice; keep live provider activation off. Once applied, pause new operations and reconcile in-flight cost before any rollback; never revive unsafe debit.

canonicalContracts: packages/agent-config/ai-usage-policy.json is new approved numeric policy source; SQL seed values are compared against it in actual local SQL tests.
User approval covers numeric policy/implementation, not cloud project creation/apply/deploy/provider topup; legacy blocked ledger is unchanged.

Request digest is keyed server HMAC of canonical feature/input/policy/route; client never chooses owner, cost, lease or pricing. Worker must use verified user and reviewed token/model bounds when integrated.

securityReview.dependencies: Registry integrity/version pin; no root dependency install; no provider API or new external credentials.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Unapplied forward SQL only, keep blocked legacy target/ledger; seed inactive campaign with no start. This is not full existing migration replay or live concurrency acceptance.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop cloud mutation, unresolved unsafe access/false-zero cost or duplicate-dispatch finding; no provider calls/live integration until authoritative token/pricing/QA gates.
